title: Compliance, Capability, and Conflict: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs under System Messages
abstract: arXiv:2608.19207v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Production deployments of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on system messages to govern model behavior. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate constraints in text only or embed them into the user turn, leaving system-message adherence in multimodal contexts largely unmeasured; they also leave open whether compliance comes at the cost of foundational vision-language capabilities. We introduce VSysBench, a benchmark built on MMVet-v2 that organizes constraints into 5 main categories and 22 sub-categories, ranging from textual directives in visual contexts to fully vision-grounded ones, each paired with a misaligned counterpart that stress-tests the instructional hierarchy. translated_title: 合规、能力与冲突：系统消息下多模态大语言模型的基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19207v1 公告类型：新 摘要：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的生产部署越来越依赖系统消息来规范模型行为。然而，现有基准要么仅评估文本中的约束，要么将约束嵌入用户轮次中，导致多模态情境下的系统消息遵循度在很大程度上未被测量；同时，这些基准也未明确合规是否以牺牲基础视觉-语言能力为代价。我们引入了VSysBench，这是一个基于MMVet-v2构建的基准，将约束组织为5个主要类别和22个子类别，范围从视觉情境中的文本指令到完全基于视觉的指令，每个类别都配有一个错位对应项，以压力测试指令层级。VSysBench通过联合满意度率（JSR）和跨约束敏感性（CCS）两个维度，对每个响应同时进行约束合规性和答案正确性的评分。在对16个MLLMs的测试中，我们发现施加系统消息会显著影响模型表现。
tldr: 本文提出了VSysBench基准，首次系统性地评估多模态大语言模型在系统消息下的约束遵循能力，并发现系统消息的施加会显著影响模型表现，揭示了合规性与视觉-语言能力之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VSysBench, the first benchmark systematically evaluating multimodal LLMs' adherence to system messages, revealing that imposing system messages significantly impacts model performance and exposes a trade-off between compliance and vision-language capabilities.
